pages.name: Spin
pages.overview: Spin focuses on outranging your enemies while also taking care of your rage bar, as your moveset uses it the most.

moves.name: Harnessing The Spin
moves.does: The player charges up a spin ball. This is a held move and once used for the first time will show a green meter next to the player until they use an ability that is not an M1. When the player would use a move that is not Q or M1, they will use up all the charge and empower that ability’s damage by a percentage that depends on the meter’s fullness. If it was maximum, the damage would be increased twofold. This move burns the meter at 1 meter per percentage and burns it fast.

moves.name: Rush Attack
moves.does: Five hit strings combo that ends in knockback.

moves.name: Off-Mode Barrage
moves.does: Rapid flurry that pushes the opponent back.

moves.name: On-Mode Heavy Strike
moves.does: Slow, powerful hit with a long wind-up.

moves.name: Lesson Two
moves.does: The player swings forward a punch, if landed, the enemy will be knocked back. This can lead to combo extend with projectiles. Has armor. Get Off me tool

moves.name: Focused Energy
moves.does: The player  punches forward with both fists. If this were to connect to an enemy, the enemy will spin on themselves and then be ragdolled.

moves.name: Curved Shot
moves.does: The player throws a curved steel ball that tracks to the nearest opponent, dealing damage if lands and stunning very little. This move only has a 6 second cooldown. The animator should make two different animations, one where they shoot left and one where they shoot right. If the first cast of this move was left shot, then the other will be a right shot

moves.name: Focused Energy
moves.does: The player throws a steel ball forward that comes back to them. If on the way back this ball would hurt an opponent, that opponent will be launched into the player, where the player will land a Spin infused punch, ragdolling.Of course, it can also hit enemies when thrown, but won't come back to the user and as such will not do the grab part.

moves.name: Overflowing Energy
moves.does: The player throws a steel ball projectile with weight that when it sticks to a surface will explode into a tornado, sending anyone inside of it upwards while ragdolling them. If the player goes inside, they will be lifted up.

moves.name: The Golden Ratio
moves.does: The player crouches as they hold their hand out to harness energy from the ground, where a golden ratio is drawn, if uninterrupted, they will be rewarded with 50 meter

moves.name: Medicinal Function
moves.does: This move is a holdable move. The player puts their hands on their arm and channels spin energy, Healing them at a rate of 1 HP per 2 Meter rapidly.
